payload.title: AI Impact on Software Jobs – Evidence Summary

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: I gave Claude Code a description of the problem, it generated what we built last year in an hour [E1] Opus combined with Claude Code now acts like a senior software engineer that follows instructions [E2]. The programmer's contribution to software work is becoming increasingly sparse, indicating a dramatic refactoring of the profession [E3].
